en.topic_title: Tai Po fire: Wang Fuk Court residents who sold titles excluded from third owners’ meeting next month
en.topic_summary:
The government-appointed administrator of fire-hit Wang Fuk Court has announced a third owners’ meeting next month, excluding residents who have sold their titles.



The area surrounding Wang Fuk Court remains blocked by police force on August 20, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.



Hop On Management announced on Monday that the third Wang Fuk Court owners’ meeting since last November’s deadly blaze will be held on December 6 at the Tai Po Community Centre. The blaze killed 168 peo
